title: Magnet: Multi-turn Tool-use Data Synthesis and Distillation via Graph Translation
venue: Proceedings of the 63rd Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
authors_zh: Fan Yin、Zifeng Wang、I-Hung Hsu、Jun Yan、Ke Jiang、Yanfei Chen、Jindong Gu、Long T. Le、Kai-Wei Chang、Chen-Yu Lee、Hamid Palangi、Tomas Pfister
paper_type_zh: 多轮函数调用轨迹合成、上下文蒸馏与偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 研究工具调用 agent 数据构造、函数调用环境、轨迹偏好对与可复现性审计的读者
one_line: MAGNET synthesizes graph-derived multi-turn function-call episodes and positive/negative trajectory pairs for SFT and mDPO, but the paper does not release the traces, executable environment, or replay metadata needed to audit the recipe end to end.
MAGNET 从 API 依赖图合成多轮函数调用轨迹，并构造正负轨迹对用于 SFT 与 mDPO；但未发布轨迹、可执行环境或回放元数据，无法端到端审计该配方。
why: It makes the data-construction interface unusually explicit: function dependencies, calls, outputs, teacher hints, SFT errors, and preference pairs are separate objects. The absence of released episodes, API versions, prompts-as-executed, licenses, and full verifier audits prevents treating the published scores as evidence of a reusable dataset.
inclusion_reason: MAGNET is a documented construction recipe for multi-turn function-call trajectories: it exposes a graph-derived tool substrate, executable reference calls, teacher-conditioned positive episodes, and contrastive negative episodes for SFT plus mDPO. It belongs to environment and agent trajectory data because the unit is a multi-turn interaction with calls and observations.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official record is an ACL 2025 long paper (pp. 32600-32616; arXiv:2503.07826v1). It targets multi-turn function calling, where an agent must compose calls, use prior outputs, and respond when functions or parameters are missing. The paper distinguishes three failures: nested calls not explicit in the user query, long dependencies across conversation turns, and irrelevant or underspecified requests that should trigger clarification rather than a call. (Paper §1, Figure 1)

The relevant data object is an agent episode, not just an answer: function signatures and dependency edges; per-turn user query; reference function calls with arguments; returned tool outputs; model action sequence; and, for preference training, a positive and negative trajectory. The paper constructs this object from a 5,011-API pool, then reports 34,000 positive SFT instances and 4,556 mDPO pairs. It does not release the episodes, stable IDs, environment package, or split manifest. (Paper §§3.3-3.7, Table 1)

This Card belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because tool calls, observations, and multi-turn state are essential to the intended record. It is not a public rollout corpus or a standalone reward dataset. The paper and appendices support an L4 description of the recipe, but release status remains partial: a reader cannot replay the claimed tool interactions or independently inspect the positive/negative pairs.

权威记录为 ACL 2025 长文（第 32600-32616 页；arXiv:2503.07826v1）。它针对多轮函数调用：agent 必须组合调用、使用此前输出，并在函数或参数缺失时作出响应。论文区分三类失败：用户问题未显式说明的嵌套调用、跨对话轮次的长依赖，以及本应澄清而不应调用的无关或信息不足请求。（论文 §1、Figure 1）

相关数据对象是一段 agent episode，而不只是一个答案：函数签名与依赖边、逐轮用户问题、带参数的参考函数调用、返回的 tool output、模型动作序列，以及用于偏好训练的一条正轨迹和一条负轨迹。论文从 5,011 个 API 的池构造该对象，随后报告 34,000 条正向 SFT 实例和 4,556 个 mDPO 对。它没有发布 episode、稳定 ID、环境包或 split manifest。（论文 §3.3-3.7、Table 1）

本卡归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为 tool call、observation 与多轮状态是该记录不可缺少的部分。它不是公开 rollout 语料，也不是独立 reward 数据集。论文及附录足以支持对配方的 L4 描述，但发布状态仍为 partial：读者无法回放所声称的工具交互，也无法独立检查正/负轨迹对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MAGNET's contribution is to convert a graph-derived function-signature path into a multi-turn query/reference-call sequence, then convert that sequence into positive and negative agent trajectories. Functions are nodes; a directed edge means one function's output is relevant to another's input. Merge, Insert, and Split modify initial paths to cover short/nested dependency, long dependency, and missing-function/parameter cases. (Paper §§3.3-3.4)

The feedback contract is mixed. First, selected StableToolBench functions are simulation-tested for executability and references are executed to obtain outputs. Second, Gemini-1.5-pro-002 supplies positive trajectories while being shown correct reference-call hints. Third, ten SFT trajectories per instance are inspected turn by turn by Gemini-1.5-pro-002; an action judged inconsistent with the reference and assigned an error type becomes a misleading hint used to sample a negative trajectory. The paper's keyword filter adds a coarse syntax/execution signal. (Paper §§3.4-3.6; Appendix A)

This observes function interfaces, reference-call outputs, and a teacher's reference-relative error judgment; it does not establish that a complete natural-language trajectory is faithful, safe, or optimal. The nearest baselines generate calls/queries from random APIs or distill teacher trajectories directly. MAGNET's narrower change is to make dependency-path construction and hint-conditioned positive/negative trajectory generation explicit. It is a data-and-environment construction recipe, not a new public verifier or benchmark. (Paper §§2-3)

MAGNET 的贡献是将从图中得到的 function-signature path 转为多轮 query/reference-call 序列，再把该序列转为正、负 agent trajectory。函数是节点；有向边表示一个函数的输出与另一个函数的输入相关。Merge、Insert 和 Split 修改初始路径，分别覆盖短/嵌套依赖、长依赖以及函数/参数缺失情形。（论文 §3.3-3.4）

反馈契约是混合式的。第一，入选的 StableToolBench 函数先经模拟调用测试可执行性，并执行 reference call 来得到输出。第二，Gemini-1.5-pro-002 在看到正确的 reference-call hint 后生成正轨迹。第三，对每个实例，先收集 10 条 SFT 轨迹，再由 Gemini-1.5-pro-002 逐轮检查；若某动作被判定与参考不一致并赋予错误类型，它就成为误导性 hint，用来采样负轨迹。论文的关键词过滤还提供粗粒度的语法/执行信号。（论文 §3.4-3.6；附录 A）

该契约观察函数接口、reference-call 输出及 teacher 相对参考的错误判断；它不能证明完整自然语言轨迹是忠实、安全或最优的。最接近的基线从随机 API 生成调用/问题，或直接蒸馏 teacher trajectory。MAGNET 较窄的改变，是显式化依赖路径构造及由 hint 条件化的正/负轨迹生成。它是数据与环境构造配方，而非新的公开 verifier 或 benchmark。（论文 §2-3）

title: Method
方法
html:
Function substrate → paths. Collect StableToolBench source-code functions and BFCL-v3 multi-turn implementations; rewrite BFCL-v3 names/descriptions so the implementation is not exposed to models. Keep StableToolBench functions with parameters that pass simulated calls, yielding 5,011 APIs across 49 cleaned categories. For each API, sample 30 same-category/class candidates and ask Gemini-1.5-pro-002 whether output-to-input dependencies create graph edges. Random walks produce initial function-signature paths. (Paper §3.4)

Path operations → query/reference sequence. Merge combines consecutive path turns; Insert adds an implicit or later reused function; Split marks a turn with miss params or miss func. Back-translation makes a user query from each signature; forth-translation makes an executable call using query and preceding outputs. The documented prompts cap a turn at three parallel calls. Executed reference calls yield the next observation. Path length, graph decisions, exact operation sampling, service versions, and replay logs are not released. (Paper §§3.3-3.4; Appendix A)

References → trajectories. Gemini-1.5-pro-002 receives correct call hints to generate positive trajectories. To create negatives, collect ten trajectories from the SFT model for each instance; have Gemini judge each turn against the reference and classify incorrect calls/summaries among nested, short-dependency, long-dependency, wrong-summary, and missing-function/parameter errors; use selected incorrect calls as wrong hints when sampling a negative trajectory. Shuffle function order and remove trajectories with strings such as Bad request or does not match. (Paper §§3.5-3.6; Appendix A)

Training. Train Qwen2.5-Coder 7B/14B on 34,000 positive trajectories, then apply mDPO plus MLE to 4,556 positive/negative pairs. Reported SFT settings include peak LR 1e-5, batch 64, warmup and linear decay. For mDPO, 7B is full-tuned at 5e-7/batch 32; 14B uses LoRA at 1e-6. Appendix B reports 16 A100 GPUs, maximum length 8,172, Adam, 0.1 warmup, and selected one-epoch SFT. No released configuration, model revision, data records, or environment permits exact reconstruction.

函数基底 → 路径。 收集 StableToolBench 源代码函数及 BFCL-v3 多轮实现；改写 BFCL-v3 名称/描述，以免模型看到实现。保留带参数且通过模拟调用的 StableToolBench 函数，得到跨 49 个清理后类别的 5,011 个 API。对每个 API，从同类别/同 class 抽取 30 个候选，由 Gemini-1.5-pro-002 判断输出到输入的依赖是否形成图边。随机游走产生初始 function-signature path。（论文 §3.4）

路径操作 → query/reference 序列。 Merge 合并相邻路径轮次；Insert 加入隐式或在后续复用的函数；Split 将一轮标为 miss params 或 miss func。back-translation 从每个 signature 生成用户 query；forth-translation 利用 query 和前面输出生成可执行调用。文档化 prompt 将一轮并行调用上限设为 3 个。执行 reference call 得到下一条 observation。路径长度、图判断、精确操作采样、服务版本和回放日志均未发布。（论文 §3.3-3.4；附录 A）

参考调用 → 轨迹。 Gemini-1.5-pro-002 接收正确调用 hint 后生成正轨迹。为构造负轨迹，每个实例先从 SFT 模型收集 10 条轨迹；Gemini 将每轮与参考比较，并把不正确的调用/摘要归为 nested、short-dependency、long-dependency、wrong-summary 或 missing-function/parameter 错误；被选中的错误调用作为错误 hint 来采样负轨迹。随后打乱函数顺序，并删除包含 Bad request 或 does not match 等字符串的轨迹。（论文 §3.5-3.6；附录 A）

训练。 在 34,000 条正轨迹上训练 Qwen2.5-Coder 7B/14B，随后对 4,556 个正/负对应用 mDPO 加 MLE。报告的 SFT 设置包括 peak LR 1e-5、batch 64、warmup 与 linear decay。mDPO 阶段，7B 以 5e-7/batch 32 全量训练，14B 以 1e-6 的 LoRA 训练。附录 B 报告 16 张 A100、最大长度 8,172、Adam、0.1 warmup 和选定的一轮 SFT。没有公开配置、模型 revision、数据记录或环境可支持精确重建。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
• Training-set scale. The reported SFT set has 20,000 single-turn, 7,800 multi-turn, and 6,200 irrelevance instances (34,000 total). The mDPO set has 1,556, 2,250, and 750 pairs (4,556 total). Reported multi-turn examples average 4.71 turns/15.13 calls for SFT and 5.22 turns/14.98 calls for mDPO. This describes an unreleased corpus, not an independently inspectable data package. (Table 1)
  • BFCL-v3 result. Magnet-14B-mDPO reports 68.01 overall and 37.88 multi-turn success, versus Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct at 51.88 overall and 5.38 multi-turn. Magnet-14B-SFT reports 66.83 overall and 33.38 multi-turn, so mDPO adds 1.18 overall and 4.50 multi-turn points in this table. The comparisons are author-reported evaluation results, not evidence that all generated trajectories are correct. (Table 2)
  • ToolQuery result. On 60 ToolQuery cases, the paper reports success/progress of 73.3/78.7 for Magnet-14B-mDPO, versus 51.7/68.7 for Qwen-Coder-14B-Instruct and 68.3/74.6 for Gemini-1.5-pro-002. The authors state ToolQuery functions are unseen in training; no item-level release was found to independently audit that assertion. (Table 3; §4.3)
  • Component ablation. In Table 4, removing positive context distillation from Magnet-14B-SFT changes overall/multi-turn from 66.83/33.38 to 60.26/18.88. Removing negative context distillation from Magnet-14B-mDPO changes 68.01/37.88 to 67.35/36.25. These are within-paper ablations and do not calibrate teacher-judge errors or the quality of every preference pair. (Table 4)
  • Contamination evidence is narrow. Appendix C reports 0.3% exact FSP matches for BFCL-v3 basic multi-turn cases, 0% for other BFCL-v3 multi-turn categories, and 5.3% 2-gram overlap. It is not a complete cross-benchmark, query-level, or release-level contamination audit. (Appendix C)

No independent reproduction, released trajectory inspection, or executable-environment replay was located.

• 训练集规模。 报告的 SFT 集含 20,000 条 single-turn、7,800 条 multi-turn、6,200 条 irrelevance 实例（合计 34,000）。mDPO 集分别含 1,556、2,250、750 个对（合计 4,556）。报告的 multi-turn 样本中，SFT 平均为 4.71 轮/15.13 次调用，mDPO 为 5.22 轮/14.98 次调用。这描述的是未发布语料，而非可独立检查的数据包。（Table 1）
  • BFCL-v3 结果。 Magnet-14B-mDPO 报告 overall 68.01、multi-turn 37.88；Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct 为 overall 51.88、multi-turn 5.38。Magnet-14B-SFT 为 66.83/33.38，故该表中的 mDPO 增加 1.18 个 overall 点与 4.50 个 multi-turn 点。这些比较是作者报告的评测结果，不是所有生成轨迹都正确的证据。（Table 2）
  • ToolQuery 结果。 在 60 个 ToolQuery 样例上，论文报告 Magnet-14B-mDPO 的 success/progress 为 73.3/78.7，Qwen-Coder-14B-Instruct 为 51.7/68.7，Gemini-1.5-pro-002 为 68.3/74.6。作者称 ToolQuery 函数未见于训练；未找到能独立审计该断言的逐项发布物。（Table 3；§4.3）
  • 组件消融。 Table 4 中，从 Magnet-14B-SFT 去除正向 context distillation 后，overall/multi-turn 从 66.83/33.38 变为 60.26/18.88；从 Magnet-14B-mDPO 去除负向 context distillation 后，68.01/37.88 变为 67.35/36.25。这些是论文内消融，不能校准 teacher judge 的错误，也不能衡量每个偏好对的质量。（Table 4）
  • 污染证据范围狭窄。 附录 C 报告 BFCL-v3 basic multi-turn 样例的 exact FSP match 为 0.3%，其他 BFCL-v3 multi-turn 类别为 0%，2-gram overlap 为 5.3%。这不是完整的跨 benchmark、逐 query 或发布级的污染审计。（附录 C）

未找到独立复现、已发布轨迹检查或可执行环境回放。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Prior tool-use data work can generate queries from APIs, randomly sample tools, or directly distill a strong model. MAGNET does not claim that tools, function calls, SFT, or preference optimization are new. Its closest comparison set includes APIGen, ToolAce, Hammer, and direct teacher trajectory distillation. (Paper §2; §4.4)

The concrete change is to make a multi-turn dependency path the intermediate construction object. Local dependency graphs and Merge/Insert/Split operations target different multi-turn failure classes before query generation. Reference calls and outputs then become hidden context hints for positive trajectories, while SFT-model errors selected by a teacher judge become deliberately misleading hints for negatives. This locates the novel data interface between executable call reference and behavior trajectory, rather than treating a tool-call answer as a single flat label.

The quality signal is conditional: Table 4 isolates components in one training setup and Appendix C gives limited FSP-overlap statistics. What remains unestablished is release-level trace quality, realistic failure coverage, verifier calibration, portable API dependency extraction, and generalization beyond English pure-text signatures. The recipe should be compared with an environment that records real API versions and per-turn execution outcomes before reuse.

已有工具使用数据工作可以从 API 生成 query、随机采样工具，或直接蒸馏强模型。MAGNET 并不声称 tool、function call、SFT 或偏好优化是新事物。其最接近的对照包括 APIGen、ToolAce、Hammer 和直接 teacher trajectory 蒸馏。（论文 §2；§4.4）

具体改变是将多轮依赖路径作为中间构造对象。local dependency graph 与 Merge/Insert/Split 在生成 query 之前针对不同多轮失败类别。随后，reference call 与输出成为正轨迹的隐藏 context hint；teacher judge 选中的 SFT-model error 则成为负轨迹的刻意误导 hint。这将新的数据接口置于可执行调用参考与行为轨迹之间，而不是把工具调用答案当作单一扁平标签。

质量信号是有条件的：Table 4 在一种训练设置中分离组件，附录 C 给出有限的 FSP overlap 统计。尚未建立的是发布级轨迹质量、真实失败覆盖、verifier 校准、可迁移的 API 依赖提取，以及超出英语纯文本 signature 的泛化。复用前应与记录真实 API 版本和逐轮执行结果的环境对照。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Environment replay is blocked. The paper describes executable calls but releases no API implementation/version manifest, tool services, response snapshots, or replay logs. Rewriting BFCL-v3 names/descriptions further prevents a released record from being directly matched to the original environment.
  • Feedback can fail. Simulation-tested function availability does not validate generated queries, argument values, summaries, or multi-turn state. Gemini reference-relative judgments can give false positives/negatives, while keyword filtering is only a rough exclusion. Neither calibration nor per-turn acceptance records are released.
  • Preference-pair provenance is incomplete. Ten SFT rollouts per instance are sampled, but their IDs, decoding settings, rejected actions, judge decisions, and final negative-trajectory linkage are unavailable. It is impossible to distinguish coverage of natural model failures from artifacts caused by wrong hints.
  • Limited scope and disclosed behavior failures. The authors state signatures are mainly English and pure text. They observe that the trained model can favor internal knowledge over conflicting tool output, and that training lacks reflection-and-restart exploration data. (Limitations)
  • Evaluation is not data-quality proof. BFCL-v3 and ToolQuery scores are aggregate results. Appendix C's FSP study does not establish no query/trajectory overlap, and ToolQuery's unseen-function assertion cannot be checked without the construction records.
  • Rights are unknown. Licenses and redistribution terms for transformed StableToolBench/BFCL-v3 functions, generated trajectories, teacher outputs, and model artifacts are not disclosed in an author release.

• 环境回放受阻。 论文描述可执行调用，却未发布 API 实现/版本清单、tool service、response snapshot 或 replay log。改写 BFCL-v3 名称/描述也使发布记录无法直接与原环境匹配。
  • 反馈可能失效。 经模拟测试的函数可用性不能验证生成的 query、参数值、摘要或多轮状态。Gemini 的相对参考判断可能产生 false positive/negative，关键词过滤也只是粗略排除。没有发布校准结果或逐轮接受记录。
  • 偏好对溯源不完整。 每个实例采样 10 条 SFT rollout，但其 ID、解码设置、被拒动作、judge 决定以及最终负轨迹链接均不可得。无法区分自然模型失败的覆盖与错误 hint 造成的 artifact。
  • 范围有限且作者披露了行为失败。 作者称 signature 主要是英语和纯文本；他们观察到训练后的模型可能偏向内部知识而忽视冲突的 tool output，且训练中没有 reflection-and-restart exploration 数据。（Limitations）
  • 评测不是数据质量证明。 BFCL-v3 和 ToolQuery 分数是聚合结果。附录 C 的 FSP 研究不能证明没有 query/trajectory overlap；ToolQuery 的 unseen-function 断言也无法在没有构造记录时检查。
  • 权利 unknown。 作者发布物未披露经转换的 StableToolBench/BFCL-v3 函数、生成轨迹、teacher 输出和模型 artifact 的许可及再分发条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, MAGNET is a design reference for separating an episode into tool substrate, dependency path, user query, executable reference, observation, policy action, and preference signal. A replication should retain stable API and episode IDs; executable reference/response snapshots; dependency decisions; every generated query and call; teacher prompts and revisions; all ten SFT rollouts; judge labels; rejected examples; positive/negative linkage; and an immutable split manifest.

It supports three concrete studies: (1) compare graph-derived paths with random same-domain API paths under the same executable environment; (2) audit whether a teacher judge's error category predicts actual replay failure, separately for calls and natural-language summaries; and (3) test whether wrong-hint negative pairs improve behavior beyond standard rejection sampling when all candidate traces are retained. A real or version-pinned simulator is needed to make these studies auditable.

Reuse class: reading and construction-audit reference only. The paper provides a reproducible conceptual pipeline and selected hyperparameters, but no released trajectories, author implementation, function environment, license-bearing package, or split. It is therefore blocked for direct training-data reuse and cannot validate an agent's tool safety from its reported benchmark scores.

对于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，MAGNET 可作为将 episode 分离为 tool substrate、dependency path、user query、executable reference、observation、policy action 与 preference signal 的设计参考。复现时应保留稳定的 API/episode ID、可执行 reference/response snapshot、依赖判断、每个生成的 query 和 call、teacher prompt 与 revision、全部 10 条 SFT rollout、judge label、被拒示例、正/负链接以及不可变 split manifest。

它支持三类具体研究：（1）在同一可执行环境下，将 graph-derived path 与随机同领域 API path 对比；（2）分别对 call 与自然语言 summary 审计 teacher judge 的错误类别是否预测真实回放失败；（3）当保留全部候选轨迹时，测试 wrong-hint 负对是否比标准 rejection sampling 带来更多行为改进。要使这些研究可审计，需要真实或版本锁定的 simulator。

复用等级：仅作阅读与构造审计参考。论文提供可重建的概念流程和部分超参数，但没有发布轨迹、作者实现、函数环境、带许可的数据包或 split。因此它不适合直接训练数据复用，也不能以报告的 benchmark 分数验证 agent 的工具安全性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Start with Figure 2 and §§3.3-3.6: the construction object is a chain from function graph to reference call/output to trajectory, not a generic chat transcript.
  • Read Appendix A's negative-hint prompt carefully: Gemini judges an SFT action against a reference response and assigns one of five error types; this is a teacher filter, not execution-grounded proof.
  • Table 1 is the key scale record: 34,000 positive SFT instances and 4,556 mDPO pairs, with different single-turn, multi-turn, and irrelevance mixtures.
  • Read Table 4 alongside Table 2: positive context distillation and negative context distillation have separate within-paper ablations, but no public pair-level audit.
  • Read Appendix C as a bounded BFCL-v3 FSP-overlap study, not as a general no-contamination claim; retain the missing environment and API-version records as the main audit boundary.

• 先读 Figure 2 与 §3.3-3.6：构造对象是一条从 function graph 到 reference call/output 再到 trajectory 的链，而不是普通 chat transcript。
  • 仔细阅读附录 A 的 negative-hint prompt：Gemini 将 SFT action 与 reference response 比较，并赋予五类错误之一；这是 teacher filter，不是执行落地的证明。
  • Table 1 是关键规模记录：34,000 条正向 SFT 实例和 4,556 个 mDPO 对，且 single-turn、multi-turn、irrelevance 的混合比例不同。
  • 将 Table 4 与 Table 2 一起读：正向 context distillation 与负向 context distillation 均有论文内消融，但没有公开的逐对审计。
  • 将附录 C 读作受限的 BFCL-v3 FSP-overlap 研究，而不是普遍的无污染声明；未发布的环境与 API-version 记录仍是主要审计边界。

value.html: Synthetic multi-turn user queries are back-translated from function signature paths drawn from StableToolBench source-code functions and BFCL-v3 multi-turn implementations. The paper collects 5,011 APIs; it rewrites BFCL-v3 function names/descriptions so only the implementation is retained, and labels function category/class with an assistant LLM.

A trajectory is a sequence of user queries, model actions, and tool responses. Model actions may contain function calls, verbal reasoning, and textual summaries; the training prompt asks for function-call-only outputs. mDPO receives paired positive and negative trajectories.

Gemini-1.5-pro-002 is the stated assistant LLM for graph judgments, back-and-forth translation, and positive trajectory generation. An SFT model produces ten candidate trajectories per instance; Gemini-1.5-pro-002 judges erroneous turns to supply misleading hints for negative-trajectory sampling.

items: function name, documentation, parameter and response information
executable reference function call and tool output
SFT candidate action and teacher error judgment

value.html: A synthetic function-call substrate built from executable functions, their input/output dependencies, reference calls, and returned outputs. Selected StableToolBench functions are simulation-tested, but the complete function implementations, service versions, runtime, and replay logs are not released.

The pipeline has two distinct checks. Executable simulation filters selected StableToolBench functions before graph construction. For negatives, Gemini-1.5-pro-002 compares an SFT-model action to a reference response and returns a yes/no judgment plus one of five error types if incorrect. Keyword filtering removes some failed calls. These are construction filters, not a public trajectory-level reward or complete correctness verifier.
No machine-readable episode-success predicate or replayable terminal-state rule is disclosed for the synthesized trajectories.
Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct.
Gemini-1.5-pro-002 is the default assistant/teacher. The ablation also uses GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct for self-improvement.

Build local dependency graphs, enhance function signature paths with Merge, Insert, and Split, back-translate paths to user queries, forth-translate executable calls with prior outputs, then use hint-based context distillation for positive and negative trajectory sampling.

For each API, sample 30 same-category/class candidates, ask the assistant to identify input/output dependencies, random-walk the graph to form initial paths, then apply Merge, Insert, and Split. Prompts cap parallel calls at three. Path length, exact operation probabilities, model decoding settings, seeds, and retry policy are not disclosed in the accessible paper text.

Shuffle available-function order in system-message instructions; discard trajectories containing failed-call keywords such as Bad request or does not match; retain SFT action errors only when the teacher judge identifies an enumerated error. Completeness and false-positive/negative rates of this filter are not reported.
unknown

SFT on 34,000 positive trajectories uses peak learning rate 1e-5, warmup and linear decay, batch size 64. mDPO uses 4,556 pairs plus MLE: full 7B tuning at 5e-7 and batch 32; 14B LoRA at 1e-6. Appendix B reports 16 Nvidia A100 GPUs, maximum length 8,172, Adam, 0.1 warmup, and hyperparameter searches; it generally selects one SFT epoch. The mDPO 14B LoRA rank/alpha are 32/64.

StableToolBench executable function source code plus rewritten BFCL-v3 multi-turn implementations -> 5,011-API pool -> LLM-labelled dependency graphs and enhanced signature paths -> synthetic queries, executable references, and outputs -> teacher positive trajectories plus SFT rollout errors -> teacher-selected wrong hints and negative trajectories -> 34,000 SFT records and 4,556 mDPO pairs.

Table 1 reports 20,000 single-turn, 7,800 multi-turn, and 6,200 irrelevance SFT samples; mDPO has 1,556, 2,250, and 750 respectively. No trajectory-level train/validation/test manifest, stable record IDs, or released records are linked.

Appendix C considers BFCL-v3 multi-turn implementation use: it reports 0.3% exact function-signature-path matches for basic multi-turn test cases, 0% for the other BFCL-v3 multi-turn categories, and 5.3% 2-gram path overlap. It does not constitute a complete data-release or benchmark-overlap audit, and no ToolQuery item-level manifest is available.

items: Reference calls and simulated function executability do not prove that teacher-generated natural-language queries, paths, summaries, or full trajectories are correct.
Gemini judgments can misclassify model actions, and the negative generator may learn artifacts of deliberately wrong hints rather than realistic failures.
Keyword-based failed-call filtering is incomplete by design and can retain malformed calls or remove valid edge cases.
BFCL-v3 implementations are deliberately rewritten and source APIs are not released with an immutable version manifest, limiting environment replay and contamination checks.

The paper states that English pure-text signatures limit language/modality generalization; it also observes conflict between tool output and model internal knowledge, and lacks reflection/restart training examples.
Reported benchmark gains do not establish quality, licensing, or safety of an unreleased training corpus.
